meta.title: Specialized Services | Nafas Beauty Clinic
meta.description: Complete range of specialized beauty and medical services at Nafas Clinic

servicesPage.heading: Our Specialized Services
servicesPage.description: Nafas Beauty Clinic offers a complete range of specialized skin and beauty services

labels.notFoundDesc: The service you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

gel-botox-injection.fullDesc: Precise filler and botox injections performed by our medical team with top international brands. We shape the lips, chin, jawline, cheeks and smile lines with natural, balanced results, and soften expression lines with botox — all in a single comfortable session with minimal downtime.

specialized-facial.fullDesc: A medical-grade facial tailored to your skin type, using pharmaceutical serums for deep hydration, brightening and renewal. Your specialist analyses your skin and combines cleansing, exfoliation and mask therapy for visible, long-lasting results.

rejuvenation-lift.fullDesc: Advanced non-surgical rejuvenation combining mesotherapy, PRP, Profhilo and lifting techniques to restore volume, elasticity and a youthful glow. We map your face and build a personalised plan that evolves with your skin over several sessions.

body-filler.fullDesc: Body shaping and volumizing with specialised fillers for bikini lines and buttocks. We design a natural silhouette, injecting precisely by the cc so you pay only for what you need, with visible results immediately.

hifu-therapy.fullDesc: Face lifting and skin tightening with focused ultrasound waves that reach deep layers without surgery. HIFU stimulates collagen and elastin production for a gradual, natural lift that strengthens over the following months.

microneedling.fullDesc: Natural collagen stimulation with fine micro-needles that renew skin texture and reduce fine lines, scars and enlarged pores. Combined with growth-factor serums, microneedling delivers a smoother, firmer and more radiant complexion over a course of sessions.

gel-botox-injection.a1: The procedure is quick; we use topical numbing cream and fine needles, so most clients feel only slight pressure.
gel-botox-injection.q2: How long do the results last?
gel-botox-injection.a2: Depending on the brand and area, most fillers last between 6 and 18 months; botox typically lasts 3 to 6 months.

specialized-facial.q1: How often should I get a facial?
specialized-facial.a1: For best results we recommend a session every 3 to 4 weeks, matching your skin's renewal cycle.
specialized-facial.a2: No. You can return to your normal routine immediately; mild redness fades within a few hours.

rejuvenation-lift.q1: How many sessions will I need?
rejuvenation-lift.a1: Most clients see clear improvement after 2 to 4 sessions; your specialist will adjust the plan based on your skin's response.
rejuvenation-lift.a2: Results appear gradually over 2 to 6 weeks as collagen is stimulated, and continue to improve over time.

body-filler.a1: When performed by an experienced physician with quality products, it is a well-established, minimally invasive procedure.
body-filler.a2: Pricing is per cc, and the required volume is determined during the consultation based on your goals.

hifu-therapy.a1: You may feel a mild warming or tingling during the session; discomfort is minimal and no anaesthesia is needed.
hifu-therapy.q2: How long do HIFU results last?
hifu-therapy.a2: Most clients maintain results for 12 to 18 months, with touch-up sessions recommended once or twice a year.

microneedling.a1: A typical course is 3 to 5 sessions, 4 weeks apart, for the best collagen remodelling.
microneedling.a2: Skin appears red like a mild sunburn for 24 to 48 hours; most clients return to work the next day.

meta.title: Care Guide | Nafas Beauty Clinic
meta.description: Complete guide to pre and post care for filler and botox treatments

care.heading: Care Guide
care.description: Following these instructions will improve your treatment results

preCare.heading: Pre-Injection Instructions
preCare.description: Important tips before visiting for filler, botox and other beauty services
preCare.noAlcoholDesc: Avoid consuming alcohol at least 24 to 48 hours before your visit.
preCare.noBloodThinnersDesc: Avoid medications like aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen, Vitamin E, omega-3 and some herbal supplements for 3 to 7 days before.
preCare.noHeavyExerciseDesc: On the day of your visit, avoid heavy exercise, sauna and hot baths.
preCare.discloseConditionsDesc: If you have active cold sores, infection, pregnancy, nursing, drug allergies or specific conditions, please inform the clinic before treatment.
preCare.drinkWaterDesc: Drinking plenty of water from one day before injection is recommended, especially for filler injection.

postCare.heading: Post-Filler Care
postCare.description: Important tips after filler injection to maintain results and prevent complications
postCare.noHeatDesc: Avoid exposing the treatment area to extreme heat such as solarium or sauna.
postCare.noAlcoholWeekDesc: Strictly avoid alcoholic beverages for one week.
postCare.noHeavyExercise48hDesc: Avoid heavy exercises for the first 48 hours.
postCare.takeCephalexinDesc: Take Cephalexin every 8 hours for three days.
postCare.vitaminCDesc: Take Vitamin C and water for one week.
postCare.contactDoctorDesc: If you experience severe pain or bruising in the first hours, inform your doctor immediately.

durability.heading: Filler Durability
durability.bodyCompatibilityDesc: Each brand is different. If someone had good results with a brand, it doesn't guarantee the same for you.
durability.areaDurabilityDesc: High-use areas like lips have less durability than chin, and smile line durability is less than angle filler.
durability.aftercareImportanceDesc: Durability depends on your care and following post-injection instructions.
durability.firstTimerNoteDesc: First-time patients need a 20-day adaptation period for the gel to adjust. Gel absorption is natural and you need at least two sessions for desired results.
